subject: The follow-up you keep meaning to send
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Quick confession: the most common reason a lead goes cold isn't price.


It's that nobody followed up.


Here's a scenario I see constantly.


A prospect fills out a form for a practice like {{business_name}}.


The owner means to reply after the last appointment of the day.


Then a no-show happens. Then a staff issue. Then it's Thursday.


By the time the message goes out, the lead has already booked somewhere else.


Look…


That isn't a discipline problem. It's a bandwidth problem.


The old way: you write every follow-up by hand, when you find time.


The AI Growth Engine way: AI drafts and sends each follow-up the moment a lead comes in — in your voice, with their name, tied to what they actually asked about.


So…


The first reply goes out in minutes, not days.


The second and third follow-ups go out on schedule, without you remembering to send them.


You only step in when someone replies and is ready to book.


This works best for businesses that book 1:1 appointments — if that's not you, feel free to skip this one.

Dylan | Digigrowth
